endpoints.name: construction_definitions
endpoints.description: Find native buildable definitions by label/name words. Returns dimensions, work, costs and allowed materials. Use explicit pagination.

endpoints.name: construction_rooms
endpoints.description: Visible rooms ordered by distance to near, with up to cell_limit explored cells nearest that point per room. The outdoors is also a native room; it is not shelter. Use area for local terrain and occupants.

near.title: Cell

endpoints.name: construction_inspect
endpoints.description: Check exact proposed placements and inspect native ready/blueprint/frame/built/rejected state. Does not place anything.

endpoints.name: construction_place
endpoints.description: Place native construction orders at inspected coordinates. Returns placement states and IDs. The integration tracks completion; do not supply a done query. Repeating the same placement returns its existing state instead of duplicating it.

endpoints.name: construction_area
endpoints.description: Inspect an explored square around an observed colony position. Returns terrain, fertility, roofs, walkability and occupying thing IDs. Unexplored cells are omitted. Start with radius 4; inspect further only when needed.
